subject: Pilot MAP & test-suite handover — Crestline trial
messages:
From: Leah Barnes <leah.barnes@crestline.ai>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot MAP & test-suite handover for Crestline trial

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Crestline is ready to run the 2-week pilot and we need to exchange the evaluation assets and agree the mutual action plan before engineering starts the integration next Monday. High-level asks from our side: 

- We need an ingestion-ready sample of the test suite (10–12k examples) + the prompt pack for automated run(s).
- Access must be ephemeral (sandbox account) and scoped to the trial repo; no redistribution outside the evaluation team.
- Acceptance criteria: top-line accuracy delta <= 2% vs our baseline on the probe set + no PII leakage reported in the first audit.

Please share your proposed MAP (milestones, owners, dates), the manifests and any constraints you require on use / retention. We can sign a short MPA (1–2 pages) to cover this. 

Attaching a short list of the test manifest fields we expect — happy to discuss.

Thanks,
Leah Barnes
Head of Evaluation, Crestline AI
leah.barnes@crestline.ai
+1 415-555-0178

Attachment: Crestline_sample_manifest.csv (csv, 1.2KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Leah Barnes <leah.barnes@crestline.ai>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP & test-suite handover for Crestline trial

Leah —

Appreciate the clear asks. Attached is a short MAP template and the prompt-pack readme that covers ingestion formats and recommended runner configs. Proposed high-level MAP: 

1) Day 0 (Mon 10 May): DocuSign MPA executed; Redwood provisions ephemeral sandbox (expires +30 days). Owner: Redwood (Jordan).
2) Day 1–2: Dataset and prompt-pack handoff (manifest + sample). Owner: Crestline (Leah) / Redwood ingestion support (Monica).
3) Day 3–9: Automated runs and baseline comparison; weekly checkpoint at Day 7. Owner: Crestline evaluation lead.
4) Day 10–12: Security audit pass / PII review. Owner: Redwood security (Karthik) + Crestline.
5) Day 13–14: Acceptance window and close decision; Redwood provides rollback/takedown steps.

Usage constraints (we propose): 
- Dataset is provided for evaluation only; no external redistribution or use for model training outside the sandbox.
- Sandbox data retention: purge 7 days after trial end unless a purchase order is issued.
- Audit & logging: we will provide request-level audit logs for the sandbox window; engineering telemetry will be accessible through the Console.

I attached Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (playbook + milestones) and promptpack_readme.md. If this looks good, I’ll send a short MPA via DocuSign and provision the sandbox as soon as the MPA is signed.

Quick Q: do you need IP/derivative language added, or is a short evaluation-only covenant sufficient?

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 9KB); promptpack_readme.md (text, 2.4KB)

From: Leah Barnes <leah.barnes@crestline.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@crestline.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 08:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP & test-suite handover for Crestline trial

Jordan —

Thanks, that MAP looks good overall. Two small asks before we sign: 

1) Access window — can we have a 30-day sandbox (not 14)? Our compliance team wants a slightly longer runway to exercise sampling. If we extend to 30 days we will of course commit to the purge timeline afterwards.
2) Audit detail — we need request-level token counts and model variant identifier in the audit logs for the acceptance review. Can you confirm both are available?

On IP, a short evaluation-only covenant is fine for us (no training / no redistribution). For good measure please add an explicit non-derivative clause for outputs that could expose sensitive proprietary prompts (we'll mark any such examples in the manifest).

We attached the sample manifest (small) you can use to validate ingestion. Once you update the MPA to reflect the 30-day window and logging specifics we’ll countersign.

Thanks —
Leah

Attachment: Crestline_sample_manifest.csv (csv, 1.2KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Leah Barnes <leah.barnes@crestline.ai>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP & test-suite handover for Crestline trial

Leah —

Perfect — we can do the 30-day sandbox. Confirming the audit data we’ll provide during the trial: per-request token counts, model variant id, request timestamp, and the per-route latency percentiles. Karthik (cc) will review the non-derivative language and add a short clause; Monica will update the MAP spreadsheet to 30-day window and include purge steps.

Next steps I’ll action today: 
- Update Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx to reflect 30-day sandbox and purge schedule, then send MPA via DocuSign (link below).
- Provision ephemeral sandbox on sign (access credentials + S3 manifest endpoint).
- Engage engineering onboarding for ingestion test in Day 1–2.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/secure signing/link/ABCDEFG
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/98765

If that’s all, expect the DocuSign envelope this afternoon — we’ll start provisioning once it’s signed. Looking forward to a smooth pilot.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
